title: Answer: consciousness is the subjective form of feeling what is against what might be

statements.text: Consciousness is a subjective form, the way some feelings are felt, that arises when an occasion feels the contrast between fact and a proposition about what might be. It is a late and flickering form of experience, not the base of experience.

sources.quote: The subjective form of the feeling of this contrast is consciousness.
consciousness is the crown of experience, only occasionally attained, not its necessary base
